node.title: Re: Net::Google::DataAPI on MacOS Catalina
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [mod://Net::Google::DataAPI] was last updated in 2014, and the [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Net-Google-DataAPI+0.2805|testers matrix] doesn't look good, especially on recent versions of Perl. Unfortunately I'm having trouble accessing the CPAN Testers reports at the moment, but it seems like you've run into [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=124866|Bug #124866]. Unfortunately the [https://github.com/lopnor/Net-Google-DataAPI|GitHub repo] hasn't really seen activity either. If it were me, I would stay away from this module as web APIs tend to evolve relatively rapidly and unfortunately an unmaintained module is unlikely to be very helpful. In fact, [https://developers.google.com/gdata/docs/directory|as far as I can tell], most GData APIs have shut down anyway. What are you trying to access? Maybe someone can suggest a better module.
